method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Indian shares seen opening lower as oil jumps on widening Mideast war
Equities.reason: Geopolitical escalation in the Middle East that lifts oil typically increases inflation and risk-off positioning, weighing on broad equity markets and EM flows. High relevance because oil-driven inflation and regional risk can change macro regime and liquidity.

Equities.title: AI investment boom puts Big Tech's free cash flow under pressure
Equities.reason: Widespread reports of heavy AI capex signal margin and free-cash-flow pressure for Big Tech — a direct fundamental headwind for the core market leadership theme. Relevant to equity multiples and the sustainability of the tech-led rally.

Equities.title: Wall St ends higher on chip stocks recovery; earnings in focus
Equities.reason: Chip/semiconductor rebound is a dominant market flow (AI-driven demand) and is lifting broader indices — a constructive risk-on signal for equities, especially tech and cyclical growth.

Equities.title: Super Micro surges 15% on new order and margin disclosure after SpaceX announcement
Equities.summary: Many server makers are seeing faster growth as companies race to deploy artificial intelligence servers.
Equities.reason: Strong single-stock/sector move reflecting the AI hardware cycle. Positive for AI infrastructure/semiconductor supply-chain sentiment; treated as higher-than-normal relevance because it evidences tangible orders/backlog trends for AI deployment.

Equities.title: Jamie Dimon says markets underestimate risks and he wouldn't buy stocks or Treasurys at current prices
Equities.summary: Comments from JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon contrast with investors' recent willingness to look past wars, tariffs and other shocks.
Equities.reason: Comments from a major bank CEO signaling elevated macro/market risk raise risk aversion and can amplify flow reversals; material to market sentiment and positioning.

Equities.title: Trump plans generic drug tariffs from 2028 with two-year delay testing U.S. onshoring push
Equities.summary: The latest tariff salvo underscored Trump's goal of reshoring low-cost drug production, but displacing established suppliers like India won't be easy.
Equities.reason: Trade/tariff policy risks raise regulatory uncertainty for pharma and supply-chain sensitive sectors. Impact is negative for policy-sensitive equities though the long lead time reduces immediacy/relevance.

Equities.title: Tehran's Hormuz threat risks global fallout, Rubio warns as U.S. strikes Iran for 11th straight night
Equities.summary: His comments come as U.S. Central Command hit Iranian targets for an 11th straight night.
Equities.reason: Escalation risk around the Strait of Hormuz raises the probability of energy-market shocks and broader risk-off moves, directly negative for global equities and investor positioning.

Equities.title: Investors Added $46B To ETFs Last Week
Equities.reason: Large ETF inflows are a market-liquidity and demand signal that supports risk assets and offsets some geopolitical/headline-driven weakness; relevant to positioning and breadth.

Equities.title: OpenAI appoints two new members to board of directors
Equities.summary: OpenAI appointed longtime financial executives David Vélez and Robin Vince to its nonprofit and for-profit boards.
Equities.reason: Governance/maturity moves at a central AI company are a modest positive for AI-sector confidence and investor sentiment, but the direct market impact is limited.

Rates.title: United Kingdom CPI inflation eases to 2.6% YoY in June vs. 2.7% forecast
Rates.summary: The United Kingdom (UK) headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 2.6% over the year in June, compared to a rise of 2.8% in May, the data released by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Wednesday.
Rates.reason: Headline CPI slowed more than expected, easing BoE tightening pressure. Softer inflation is bond-positive (yields likely to drift lower / gilts rally), a clear rates transmission signal.

Rates.title: JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon made bearish call on treasury bond market. Many investors already acted on it
Rates.summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon warned this week long-term treasuries are not a good buy, even if stocks fall. Many investors already acted on that message this year.
Rates.reason: High-profile warning that long-dated Treasuries are unattractive reinforces bearish positioning in US bonds and supports higher yields / sell-off in long-end; market-impacting sentiment signal.

Rates.title: Bank of America CEO warns inflation will back Fed into a corner
Rates.reason: Senior bank CEO warning that inflation could force the Fed to act (higher-for-longer) pushes expectations of additional tightening — negative for bond prices (yields up).

Rates.title: Japan 40-Year Bond Sale Sees Strongest Demand Since March 2025
Rates.reason: Robust demand at a long-dated JGB auction signals strong buyer appetite for duration in Japan (gilt-like rally for JGBs / lower yields), relevant to Asia fixed income and global duration flows.

Rates.title: Thai Bonds Are Beating Asia and Analysts Predict Further Gains
Rates.reason: Reported regional bond rally (weaker inflation / reduced supply) points to tighter Asian sovereign spreads and lower yields regionally — positive for local rates and Asia fixed-income sentiment.

FX.title: Euro gains ground above 1.1400 on hawkish ECB tone
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair holds positive ground near 1.1410 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday, bolstered by a hawkish tone from the European Central Bank (ECB).
FX.reason: ECB adopting a hawkish tone is a direct FX driver for EUR/USD; supports near-term euro strength vs. the dollar and is a meaningful macro driver for the USD-centric currency basket.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index weakens to near 101.00 despite mounting Middle East tensions
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 101.15 in the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The DXY declines amid US Federal Reserve (Fed) rate uncertainty.
FX.reason: DXY weakening signals broad dollar softness driven by Fed/rate uncertainty — a cross-cutting FX theme that lifts non‑USD pairs and influences capital flows across majors and EMFX.

FX.title: Yen Slides Past 163 Mark to Fresh Four-Decade Low Against Dollar
FX.reason: USD/JPY breaking four-decade lows for the yen is a major FX regime signal (USD strength/JPY weakness) with explicit intervention risk implications and large cross‑market flow consequences.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Likely to extend rally towards 164.00
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) hovers near a multi-decade high at around 163.24 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Wednesday. The USD/JPY pair reflects significant strength as the Japanese currency underperforms due to surging Oil
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece reinforcing a strong USD/JPY trend; underlines continuation risk to yen weakness and supports the broader dollar‑strength narrative (intervention risk flagged).

FX.title: Swiss Franc weakens as risk aversion support US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/CHF continues its winning streak for the third successive day, trading around 0.8130 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) receives support from growing risk aversion tied to escalating geopolitical tensions betwe
FX.reason: USD strength supported by risk aversion is driving CHF weakness; this is consistent with a broader dollar‑safe‑haven bid and contributes to cross‑market FX flows.

FX.title: Indian Rupee resumes decline as oil prices rise further
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday after a slight relief the previous day. The USD/INR pair rises to near 96.45 as a fresh surge in oil prices due to intensifying fears of further global energy supply disruptions has we
FX.reason: Oil-driven EMFX pressure: rising oil pushes USD/INR higher (INR weakening), signalling commodity‑linked currency stress and importers' FX vulnerability — a clear EM transmission channel.

FX.title: British Pound remains depressed against US Dollar following soft UK inflation data
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) consolidates losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, as a string of UK inflation figures provided some leeway for the Bank of England to maintain its “wait-and-see” stance through the coming months.
FX.reason: Soft UK inflation reduces the BoE's tightening impulse, pressuring GBP vs USD. This is a direct macro driver for GBP/USD and fits a narrative of dollar resilience while some G10 currencies soften.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar gives away gains as Iran’s war offsets RBNZ’s hawkishness
FX.summary: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) is trading lower against the US Dollar (USD) for the second consecutive day on Wednesday, as the US-Iran conflict overshadows the Reserve Bank of New Zealand’s (RBNZ) hawkish monetary policy stance.
FX.reason: Geopolitical risk is offsetting local hawkish policy support for NZD, causing NZD weakness vs USD; represents risk‑driven dollar demand rather than domestic policy divergence.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $60.00 despite surging inflation fears
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground for the fourth successive day, trading around $59.70 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Silver prices are surging despite rising rate-hike expectations, as powerful market forces outweigh the drag of higher
Commodities.reason: Silver is rallying toward $60/oz — a direct price move in an allowed commodity. This is primarily a short-term price/forecast piece (technical/market momentum), so positive direction but capped relevance.

Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) gives back some of its early gains, but is still 0.8% higher at around $59.25 during the European trading session on Wednesday.
Commodities.reason: Intraday technical/price-action note on silver. Positive but low relevance (technical/forecast content capped).

Commodities.summary: ING’s commodities team notes Gold and Silver have extended gains on dip-buying and geopolitical concerns in the Middle East. They highlight Gold trading above $4,000/oz and Silver near $60/oz, supported by safe-haven flows and stronger industrial metals sentim
Commodities.reason: Macro note: safe-haven flows amid Middle East tensions are lifting gold and silver. This ties geopolitical risk to precious metals — high relevance and material upside for gold.

Commodities.title: Gold nears two-week high as Fed outlook, Middle East conflict stay in focus
Commodities.reason: Wire confirmation that gold is firmer on Fed outlook and Middle East conflict; reinforces the safe-haven narrative for precious metals with moderate relevance.

Commodities.summary: In Wednesday’s Asian session, the US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told Southeast Asian foreign ministers that Iranian control of the Strait of Hormuz, a vital passage to almost 20% of global energy supply, would set a dangerous precedent with repercussions b

Commodities.summary: Yemen’s Houthis said that they have closed the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to Saudi-linked shipping in retaliation for the kingdom’s blockade on Yemen and a recent attack on the international airport in Yemen’s rebel-held capital, Sanaa, the Guardian reported on Wedn
Commodities.reason: Direct report of a threatened chokepoint (Bab el-Mandeb) — material upside for oil via shipping disruption risk. High relevance to crude market risk premia.

Commodities.title: Petroleum markets responded to disruptions in the Middle East in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) were characterized by continued disruptions to international crude oil and petroleum product flows through the Strait of Hormuz, contributing to higher and more volatile crude oil prices through most of th
Commodities.reason: EIA analysis documenting real supply disruptions through Hormuz and resulting higher, more volatile crude prices — high-authority signal that materially supports oil upside.

Commodities.title: Houthi Blockade Could Worsen an Already Fragile Oil Market
Commodities.reason: Major media reporting on Houthi blockade risks to oil shipping lanes; reinforces the supply-risk narrative and raises oil risk premium.

Commodities.title: Trump vows to attack Iranian nuclear facility as Middle East war escalates
Commodities.summary: Goldman Sachs warns oil could jump to $120 per barrel if Strait of Hormuz remains ‘disrupted’
Commodities.reason: Escalation risk and institutional forecast of a large oil price spike if Hormuz is disrupted — significant upside geopolitical shock for crude; high relevance.

Commodities.title: What are tank bottoms?
Commodities.summary: Crude oil inventories held at storage facilities in Cushing, Oklahoma, fell below 20 million barrels during the week ending June 19 until the week ending July 10, according to our Weekly Petroleum Status Report.
Commodities.reason: EIA note on Cushing inventory drawdowns — supportive for WTI prices (physical storage drawdown = bullish signal). Moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Global liquefied natural gas trade volumes reached record high in 2025
Commodities.summary: Global liquefied natural gas (LNG) trade volumes increased 5.4% to a record 56.3 billion cubic feet per day last year (Bcf/d), driven largely by U.S. LNG export capacity expanding to meet growing demand, according to a recent report from the International Grou
Commodities.reason: Record LNG trade volumes driven by rising US export capacity point to stronger structural demand/support for natural gas prices.

Commodities.title: America’s Most Prolific Oil Field Has a Natural-Gas Problem
Commodities.reason: Headline suggests a supply/processing or takeaway issue creating headwinds for associated natural gas flows/prices in a major US field — negative for natgas.

Commodities.title: Indian Refiners Come to the Rescue of Russia’s Oil Exporters
Commodities.reason: Shifts in trade flows (Indian refiners absorbing Russian barrels) increase available export outlets and can dampen some sanction-driven price pressure — modestly bearish for global crude.

Crypto.reason: Policy uncertainty: bipartisan Clarity Act momentum threatened by Democratic resistance, increasing regulatory uncertainty that undercuts recent bullish narratives around formal U.S. crypto clarity.

Crypto.reason: Market reaction to regulatory progress: comments signaling imminent passage of a Clarity Act variant are a clear positive driver for BTC and flows (ETF/institutional narrative).

Crypto.title: White House pushes Senate Democrats to take 'historic' crypto Clarity Act ethics deal
Crypto.reason: Executive-branch push increases odds of legislative compromise; reinforces the dominant bullish narrative that regulatory clarity may be imminent and is supporting markets.

Crypto.title: Crypto markets rally on Clarity progress report, Asian chip-stock rebound
Crypto.reason: Market-level confirmation: Clarity Act progress combined with other risk-on cross-asset flows is a near-term positive for crypto prices and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin rally has broad-based support as institutions, whales, options traders pile in
Crypto.reason: Flow-driven bullishness: institutional and derivatives positioning supporting the rally signals stronger demand and structural support for BTC price action.

Crypto.title: Live markets: Bitcoin pulls back from five-week high on new Trump threats over Iran
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical risk: escalation headlines produced a short-term risk-off reaction that pulled BTC back from highs; represents a notable but not dominant counterforce to the clarity/flow narrative.

Crypto.title: Russia’s parliament passes crypto market law with $3,800 annual cap for retail investors
Crypto.reason: Regulatory tightening: a hard cap on retail investment is a meaningful negative for market access and demand in a major jurisdiction, weighing on global appetite for risk assets including crypto.

Crypto.title: Movement Labs files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy months after token scandal
Crypto.reason: Idiosyncratic solvency shock: another token-related bankruptcy undermines trust in certain token projects and is a negative for sector sentiment, though it's not systemic.

Crypto.title: Crypto lobby group Digital Chamber sues Illinois to block digital asset tax
Crypto.reason: Legal pushback against taxes: industry litigation to block a new digital-asset tax is a modest positive for market participants if it succeeds, reducing near-term regulatory/regressive cost risks.

Crypto.title: Galaxy sets up $5 million fund to help shield Bitcoin against quantum computing threats
Crypto.reason: Security/technology investment: proactive funding to address quantum risk is a small positive for long-term confidence in Bitcoin's security model.

Crypto.title: Claude's Fable 5 just solved an 87-year-old math problem, and it matters for bitcoin
Crypto.reason: Technology advance: AI solving a longstanding math problem tied to Bitcoin-related cryptography is a modest positive for protocol research and long-term robustness.

Crypto.title: Augustus raises $180 million to build a clearing bank for the AI and stablecoin era
Crypto.reason: Infrastructure funding: large capital raise to create stablecoin/clearing infrastructure supports on-ramps and institutional adoption — a constructive medium-term development for crypto.

Crypto.title: UK Parliament begins inquiry into banking chokepoint for crypto businesses
Crypto.reason: Regulatory/infrastructure inquiry: UK scrutiny of banking access could alleviate a major operational bottleneck for crypto firms if it leads to reforms — net positive for ecosystem functioning.

Crypto.title: AI models escaped OpenAI’s sandbox and hit Hugging Face. Crypto is where that gets dangerous
Crypto.reason: Operational/security risk: AI model proliferation creating new attack vectors for smart contracts and on-chain systems is a modest negative for short-term security sentiment and risk premium.

Crypto.title: Inside Cardano's 'Van Rossum' hard fork, and what it means for users
Crypto.reason: Protocol upgrade: chain-level hard fork is a positive technical development for Cardano users and ecosystem stability, but limited market-wide impact.
